Resolves #20564

Disabling grid column menus could unregister their trigger buttons while a live header vnode still referenced them, causing ancestor updates to throw `Component not found`. The plugin now uses the existing component destruction contract to retire those references synchronously and retains its batched owner update.

Change class: restoration. No new API or user obligation. The manual child-filtering code is removed.

Evidence: L3 (existing BigData browser journey plus a red-first rendered lifecycle regression) → L3 required. No residual acceptance work.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `HeaderMenu.spec.mjs`: rendered disable checks ancestor traversal synchronously before awaiting the next projection; fails on the unchanged base with the CI signature. |
| AC-2 | The same regression verifies completed removal, live replacement triggers after re-enable, and safe grid destruction with inline filters. Existing HeaderMenu coverage retains source/filter ownership. |
| AC-3 | Focused HeaderMenu units and both existing BigData browser tests pass. No error expectations, retries or timeouts changed. |

## Deltas from ticket

The parent cleanup is used only while the header remains live. An unconditional `destroy(true, true)` exposed an inline-filter teardown hazard: the owner had already destroyed that sibling. Reusing the existing owner-liveness guard for both trigger removal and the batched update preserves owner teardown and fixes runtime toggling.

Prescription checked: `src/component/Abstract.mjs#destroy` owns parent VDOM removal and stored-vnode retirement; `Menu.destroy` consumes that contract. Strict VNode traversal is unchanged.

## Test Evidence

- New rendered regression failed on base `951114cc6a` with a missing retired trigger, then passed with this repair.
- `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/BigDataNL.spec.mjs`: 2 passed in 7.7s, clean worker-error fixture, no retries.
- The initial failure was observed twice on unrelated Demo B PR `#20546`; its [CI record](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20546#issuecomment-6709963735) preserves both attempts and the independent source census.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; shared PR-body and substrate-size baseline checks apply in CI.
